purpose: Control what information is visible in private case views versus public answer views while preserving evidence integrity, privacy and auditability.
core_principle: PRIVATE CASE DATA ≠ PUBLIC ANSWER DATA
private_case_may_include: property identifiers needed for the investigation
restricted source details where access is lawful
rules: Public answer should expose only information necessary to understand and act on the verified result.
Private case access does not automatically confer public disclosure rights.
Official public availability does not mean every derived personal-data field should be republished.
A citizen's document can be used privately without being reproduced publicly.
Property-specific answers must avoid unnecessary identification of individuals.
Publication must preserve material evidence limitations.
Public rendering must not disclose restricted source material merely to make the answer appear more authoritative.
hard_stops: Never expose restricted evidence because it supports an answer.
Never remove a material limitation merely to simplify public presentation.
Never treat private case metadata as public evidence.
Never allow publication to bypass privacy/access review.
